notes.title: Barry of Wrath receives positive Steam Rating
notes.notes:
Barry of Wrath has achieved a significant milestone.

Thank you everyone for your support.

It's a blessing to have such a supportive community of players who give honest feedback and appreciate these titles!

I just wanted to take the time to thank all of you that send me messages, write in the forums and those who also take the time to write reviews.
I cannot stress enough how much this helps - especially considering I'm a solo developer.

Shane of Wolfs Moon Studios
